_comment: The crucible furnace's build (#796, #711): each stage after the iron frame and its materials, from CrucibleFurnace/README.md and the rig's build.stages (cruciblefurnace-rig.json), in order; read by Machines/Core/MachineBuildJson.cs (its schema); docs/modeling/machine-base.md. The brickwork is any one fired brick (oneType: the first sets the furnace's brick type; the codes are the rig's bricks.types, red first for the creative shortcut), its hinge's iron coming with it; the lid stage brings the damper (its places are the furnace's state). The outlet's cap is not a stage (CrucibleFurnace/Game/BECrucibleFurnace.cs). No block: the recipe export writes no construction record for it. No part wears.
